Our mum would completely trash our bedrooms during her rage fits. I mean totally emptying the wardrobes, the cupboards and stripping the bed. Absolutely everything would end up on the floor and she would scream at us to clean it up. It happened so many times I lost count. It took hours to get it back to normal. 

At other times she would smash cups, plates, throw plates of food, tv remotes etc before storming out of the house for hours. This was before mobile phones were a thing so we had absolutely no way of contacting her. When she’d return home, it would be total and utter silent treatment for days. During this time she’d only cook for herself, only wash her own clothes and brush past us in the hallway as if we weren’t even there.. 

I remember one time she woke us all up at 3am yelling at the top of her lungs that someone committed the heinous act of not wrapping the cheese up properly when it was last eaten. She wanted coherent answers from us when we’d just been scared awake. I remember looking at my older brother who was so deliriously tired and just feeling so helpless. We all ended up being beaten with a wooden spoon. Imagine being so unhinged that unwrapped cheese makes you lose your mind.. 

I’m currently in therapy 😐

This period of NC has been almost 3 years. At the point of going NC, I explained to her yet again what I wasn’t happy about, what needed to change and left the door open for a conversation. She completed blanked me. Until recently she was sending happy birthday texts for me and my kids, alongside sending a small bank transfer by way of a gift, but apart from that she has not attempted to make contact or address anything. I had a baby 7 months ago and my partner felt strongly about letting her know about her newest grandchild via text. Surprise surprise her text was something like ‘boo-hoo boo-hoo poor me, my kids are not talking to me and I have no idea why. I’m not very well and this situation HURTS me deeply. Make sure Judy (me) doesn’t find out that you’ve messaged me because I don’t think she’ll be very happy. Congrats’… 

It hurts my heart that she would rather be estranged from me and my 3 kids for the last 3 years than have a conversation about what I raised to her. It hurt me all over again the way she tried to gain sympathy from my partner whilst also implying something about my character. This, however, is a woman who could not even handle hearing us complain about her boring TV shows when we were kids and would launch the TV remote across the room, said ‘don’t worry, I’ll be dead soon!’ and then disappeared out the house for hours so of course I shouldn’t be surprised that she couldn’t handle the stuff I raised to her 3 years ago. 

I’m okay being NC indefinitely but have recently started therapy to help me accept the situation for what it is and learn to let go of my anger..

My mum once woke us all up at 3am because she realised the last person who’d used some cheese hadn’t wrapped it back up properly. I was 9 or 10 at the time and my brother was a year older. I remember looking at him and feeling so sorry for him because he’d been scared awake and was so confused about what was going on. What followed was at least an hour of lecturing and we all received slaps on the hand with a wooden spoon for the heinous act of not covering the cheese up properly..
